### 2026-10-07 – # JOURNAL NUM1!!!!!

**2h**

# JOURNAL NUM1!!!!!
Ok so kind of late to the party since school is just getting bussy, but here is a little overview of what I did here.
+ I rounded my price point to 65$ as a starting point
+ Generated a few of the components
+ Chose a few components that are economically viable

Ok so the real issue here is price of hour works, since I dont think I can do 20 hours in these 4 days, I might be able to undo a few of my ideas to the "essence" of the project. This includes, split keyboard, mouse integrated, and clicky keycaps. I also designed a nice setup for my hands!

### 2026-10-08 – # CHECKPOINT NUM 2!!!!

**2h**

# CHECKPOINT NUM 2!!!!
Okay so this is half of the keyboard done I chose the layout that seemed most attractive and comfortable, for me, I also made the schematic and PCB, of the left half, on checkpoint one I planned the most budget friendly option. Here is what I did today!
+ Chose keyboard layout
+ Schematic of left side
+ PCB of left side

I designed so the left side pretty much just connects like a controller to the right side, the right side has the battery, micro controller and usb connection so that will take me longer.

![check1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qOiKwH2hiQ2yszrS5dgOmXsDdMu7PMIV/aea8cc69fdebf647998f2a7272d80b1eff54d889eb566a6cd915835bb0fae20c.png)

### What I had problems with?
Its my first time making a keyboard, not only the format so I had some trouble working the footprints and silkscreen but I think it looks good, I am also going to see if someone can help me design a few mounting holes for the pcb since Ive never done accurate edgecuts apart from a simple cube

![left](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/qOiKwH2hiQ2yszrS5dgOmXsDdMu7PMIV/7b1862e00d2038c156e2ab8075de9b4c25eb67ca7198484cf3eaa312897e4410.png)
